title: Probing the 'I know but won't say' link: detecting withheld knowledge via concept vectors

original_idea.body: Train a withholding-known-info probe from instructed-sandbagging vs genuine-ignorance contrasts; test separation via AUROC; instructed sandbagging as model-organism proxy.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: internal sandbagging detection targets a recognized dangerous-capability-eval threat (level 4).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Linear probe + instructed-sandbagging contrast on one open model; guided (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped with clear success criterion (withhold-vs-ignorance AUROC) (level 5).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Sandbagging detection is neglected, externally valuable monitoring infra (level 5).

low_compute.reasoning: Probe + inference, no training; single GPU.

novelty.reasoning: Internal sandbagging detection described as open/neglected; mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Internal sandbagging detection appears mostly novel.
